title: Search
subtitle: Find a word or an idea in every episode: in titles and in what was said.
start-body: Type a word or an idea and press Enter. You'll see which episodes mention it, and where.
error-body: Check your connection and try again.
empty-body: Try fewer or other words. Only episodes with a transcript can be searched inside; open an episode to make one.
library-failed: Your transcript library couldn't be searched.
unmatched_one: 1 more episode in your transcript library matches, but it isn't in your podcasts.
unmatched_other: {{count}} more episodes in your transcript library match, but they aren't in your podcasts.
play-failed: This episode couldn't play. Try again.
